name: CompAI CRM
tagline: An open-source, agent-native CRM designed for AI agents
description: CompAI CRM is an open-source CRM built with an agentic-first design, in TypeScript. Rather than treating AI as an add-on, it is architected for AI agents as first-class users that can operate the pipeline directly. It targets teams who want AI agents driving sales workflows instead of humans clicking through traditional CRM forms.
highlights: TypeScript codebase under an open source license
Designed for AI agents as first-class pipeline operators
8.1k stars in just 10 days on launch
curatorNote: A CRM built for agents rather than adapted for them is a meaningful shift — 8.1k stars in ten days shows real demand for agent-operable business software.
